titles.title: Untitled (Banana Flower)

description: The leaves of a banana flower hang upside down, some wrapping around the plant's center and some curling upward. Above, larger leaves overlap and frame the bloom. A plain white background fills the lower half of the composition.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
